verdict.rationale: Composio documents an official hosted MCP server, Composio Connect at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp, that any MCP-compatible client can use. It also offers per-session hosted MCP servers via `mcp: true` and custom single-toolkit MCP servers via `composio.mcp.create`, and a probe independently confirms the official MCP server documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully through the MCP endpoints.
